definition: [ דָּגַל ] verb look, bahold (Assyrian dagâlu , Lotz TP 131 ; Thes Rob-Ges MV SS De make דָּגוּל a denominative from דֶּגֶל = lifted up like a banner , or furnished with a banner , i.e. exalted, distinguished , AV RV chiefest ); — Passive participle דָּגוּל מֵרְבָבָה Song 5:10 looked at, conspicuous , according to Dl HA 40 .
